title: First Item
statement: Implement `solve(items)`. Return the first element of a non-empty list. If the list is empty, return the string `error`. Do not index an empty list.
constraints: The first element keeps its type, int or string
hints: The error string is the empty case.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A function annotated to return a value, not an optional, must refuse the empty sequence.

editorial: A function annotated to return a value, not an optional, must refuse the empty sequence. Indexing it raises IndexError. Checking first makes the failure the string the caller expects in this sandbox. The element itself is returned unchanged.
